title: GLM-5.3 NVFP4-CSF on six Sparks
evidence_scope: Research-only TP6 draft for positions 0-5 of an eight-Spark cycle, with SIRCL and NCCL off. Uses the pinned CSF serving directory with in-memory HF overrides: 66 attention heads and 2304 expert columns (384 per rank), DCP2, 32 GiB KV per rank, 135168-token maximum sequence, eight sequences and two-token MTP. CPU configuration and universal-route tests plus RTX 5090 collective emulation; no DGX RDMA, model correctness or throughput measurement at TP6. Requires the updated SIRCL route-scope adapter and runtime-status resident-method collector. Requires a separate v3 image lock admitting this profile and the indexer plugin on the pinned CSF-capable build. No shipped lock admits it. See the profile guide for omitted TP8-only speedups and capacity limits. Not serving-qualified.
